name: phonon
about: Phonon (gradium-ai/xn-ptts: Rust runtime, no PyTorch) on Windows, macOS and Linux, CPU (x86 needs AVX2): small, fast, streaming; English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese; voices by name from the gradium/phonon-voices catalog (ptts --list-voices)
license: ptts runtime MIT or Apache-2.0; model Phonon 31m (English) Apache-2.0: commercial use allowed. Phonon 40m and 40m multilingual (fr, de, es, pt) are CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial only, and gated (accept the terms on Hugging Face, then set HF_TOKEN)
